title: Appendix A: The CAR Hierarchical Models
text: UCAR model used RSTr based model developed Besag, York, Mollié (1991) modifications using inverse transform sampling restricted informativeness based Quick, et al. (2021): models using method = "binomial", \[ \begin{split} Y_{} &\sim \text{Binomial}(n_{}, \theta_{}) \\ \theta_{} &\sim \text{LogitNormal}(\beta_{j} + Z_{}, \tau^2), \\ &=\{1,...,N_s\}, j =\{1,...,N_{}\} \end{split} \] models using method = "poisson", \[   \begin{split} Y_{} &\sim \text{Poisson}(n_{} \theta_{}) \\ \theta_{} &\sim \text{LogNormal}(\beta_{j} + Z_{}, \tau^2), \\ &=\{1,...,N_{s}\},\ j =\{1,...,N_{}\} \end{split} \] models, \[ \begin{split} \beta_{j} &\sim \text{Normal}(0,\sigma_{\beta}^2),\ \sigma_{\beta}^2 \\infty \\ Z &\sim \text{CAR}(\sigma^2) \\ \sigma^2 &\sim \text{InvGamma}(a_\sigma,b_\sigma) \\ \tau^2 &\sim \text{InvGamma}(a_\tau,b_\tau) \end{split} \]

title: Appendix A: The CAR Hierarchical Models
text: MCAR model used RSTr based model developed Gelfand Vounatsou (2003): models using method = "binomial", \[ \begin{split} Y_{ik} &\sim \text{Binomial}(n_{ik}, \theta_{ik}) \\ \theta_{ik} &\sim \text{LogitNormal}(\beta_{jk} + Z_{ik}, \tau_k^2), \\ &=\{1,...,N_s\}, k =\{1,...,N_{g}\}, j=\{1,...,N_{}\} \end{split} \] models using method = "poisson", \[ \begin{split} Y_{ik} &\sim \text{Poisson}(n_{ik}, \theta_{ik}) \\ \theta_{ik} &\sim \text{LogNormal}(\beta_{jk} + Z_{ik}, \tau_k^2), \\ &=\{1,...,N_s\}, k =\{1,...,N_{g}\}, j=\{1,...,N_{}\} \end{split} \] models, \[ \begin{split} \beta_{jk} &\sim \text{Normal}(0,\sigma_{\beta}^2),\ \sigma_{\beta}^2 \\infty \\ Z &\sim \text{CAR}(G) \\ G &\sim \text{InvWishart}(\nu,G_0) \\ \tau^2 &\sim \text{InvGamma}(a_\tau,b_\tau) \end{split} \]

title: Appendix A: The CAR Hierarchical Models
text: MSTCAR model used RSTr based model developed Quick, et al. (2017): models using method = "binomial", \[ \begin{split} Y_{ikt} &\sim \text{Binomial}(n_{ikt}, \theta_{ikt}) \\ \theta_{ikt} &\sim \text{LogitNormal}(\beta_{jkt} + Z_{ikt}, \tau_k^2), \\ &=\{1,...,N_s\},\ k =\{1,...,N_g\},\ t=\{1,...,N_t\},\ j=\{1,...,N_{}\} \end{split} \] models using method = "poisson", \[ \begin{split} Y_{ikt} &\sim \text{Poisson}(n_{ikt} \theta_{ikt}) \\ \theta_{ikt} &\sim \text{LogNormal}(\beta_{jkt} + Z_{ikt}, \tau_k^2), \\ t &=\{1,...,N_t\},\ =\{1,...,N_s\},\ k=\{1,...,N_g\},\ j=\{1,...,N_{}\} \end{split} \] models, \[ \begin{split} \beta_{jkt} &\sim \text{Normal}(0,\sigma_{\beta}^2),\ \sigma_{\beta}^2 \\infty \\ Z &\sim \text{MSTCAR}(\mathcal{G}, \mathcal{R}), \ \mathcal{G}=\{G_1,...,G_{N_t}\}, \ \mathcal{R}=\{R_1,...,R_{N_g}\} \\ G_t &\sim \text{InvWishart}(A_G, \nu) \\ A_G &\sim \text{Wishart}(A_{G_0}, \nu_0) \\ R_k &= \text{AR}(1,\rho_k) \\ \rho_k &\sim \text{Beta}(a_{\rho}, b_{\rho}) \\ \tau_k^2 &\sim \text{InvGamma}(a_\tau,b_\tau) \end{split} \]
